newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine jet crashes during show, kills two.
newsitem.headline: Philippine jet crashes during show, kills two.

text.p: A Philippine Air Force F-5 fighter jet crashed on Monday while making a fly-past during an official ceremony, killing its pilot and a man on the ground, an air force officer said.

One other civilian on the ground, a boy, survived with injuries after the aircraft nose-dived while taking off from Basa air base in Pampanga province just north of Manila, staff sergeant Ronilo Montante said in a radio interview.
The jet fighter was one of four F-5s making a fly past over Basa airbase at the start of a parade marking the handover of the air force's 5th Fighter Wing to a new commander.
But the aircraft, piloted by a lieutenant, failed to gain altitude and crashed, bursting into flames and killing an old man, Montante said.
The boy has been taken to hospital.
